s: Din semikut geulla litpilla ubo d' seipim: (ap al pi sheqqeriat shema ubirkoteha mitzva bipne atzmah utepilla mitzva bipne atzmah) tzarik lismok birkat geulla litpilla, velo yapsiq benehem apillu beamen achar "gaal yisrael", velo beshum pasuq shennohagin lomar qodem tepillat y"ch, kegon pasuq "ki shem Hashem eqra" vedomayv, chutz mippasuq "adonai sepatay tiptach", shehu choba mittaqqanat chakamim veeno chashub hepseq, shekkevan sheqqebauhu chakamim battepilla — naasa mikkelal hattepilla vekitpilla arukka hi. Veyesh omerim shemmuttar laanot amen achar "gaal yisrael". Veken nohagin, kemo shennitbaer besiman s"v. Ubemusap umincha sheen sham semikat geulla litpilla — muttar lomar pesuqim qodem "adonai sepatay tiptach", abal lo acharayv mishshum hepseq battepilla, shehare pasuq zeh mikkelal hattepilla hu:

Yesh mi sheomer shebbeshabbat en tzarik lismok geulla litpilla, mippene shessemika zo lemaduha chakamim mimmah shekkatub: "yihyu leratzon vego' tzuri vegoali", uketib acharayv: "yaanka Hashem beyom tzara", abal shabbat lav yom tzara hu. Veyamim tobim dinam kechol, hoil vehem yeme haddin, shebbappesach haolam niddon al hattebua, ubaatzeret al perot hailan, ubechag al hammayim. Veen lismok al sebara zo im lo bemaqom shetztzarik lekak, lepi shellimmud zeh eno ella semek bealma, veiqqar semikat geulla litpilla hu middibre chakamim sheddimmu y"ch berakot achar birkat geulla leohabo shel melek shebba vedapaq al petach hammelek veyatza hammelek liqrato, veim roehu hammelek shehiplig vehalak lo ap hu maplig, veshub en mitqareb elayv keshechozer vedopeq — kak hu bemapsiq ben geulla litpilla:

Hashsheliach tzibbur keshemmatchil y"ch beqol — tzarik lomar techilla pasuq "adonai sepatay tiptach", hoil vehu mikkelal hattepilla. Vetob sheyyomrennu belachash. Abal shear pesuqim en tzarik lomar. Veim ratza lomar — rashshay, veen issur kelal lehapsiq (beinyene hattepilla utzerakeha) ben tepillat lachash litpilla shebbeqol (abal lehitasseq bidbarim acherim asur ad achar nepilat appayim, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ql"a):

Im ad shello qara qeriat shema ubirkoteha matza tzibbur shemmitpalelin — lo yitpallel immahem techilla veliqrot achar kak qeriat shema ubirkoteha kemo sheosim bipsuqe dezimra, lepi shessemikat geulla litpilla shacharit gedola mittepilla im hatztzibbur (abal bearbit tepillat hatztzibbur gedola missemikat geulla litpilla, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman rl"v):
